premises.text: Average users do not know what data they generate, who can see it, or how to secure it while data harvesters monetize them
premises.evidence_span: the average user has no idea what data they're generating or who can see it, let alone how to actually secure their data

premises.text: Users sync platforms like Facebook and Google to see personal data organized, anonymized, and encrypted
premises.evidence_span: Simply sync your platforms, like Facebook and Google, to see all of your personal data organized in simple categories, fully anonymized and encrypted

premises.text: Reverse subscription lets approved companies pay users monthly for access to anonymized data
premises.evidence_span: Ozone offers a reverse subscription model where companies you approve can pay to subscribe to your anonymized data

premises.text: Patented encryption gives only the user the private key while encrypted ML matches shareable data to offers
premises.evidence_span: Our patented technology encrypts your data and only you have the private key

premises.text: Businesses get pre-approved audiences matched to zip, age, gender, and category for high-conversion targeting
premises.evidence_span: Ozone will return pre-approved audiences that match your targeted profile

premises.text: Freemium: consumers get free organize/secure tools; companies pay for conversions not just eyeballs
premises.evidence_span: consumers get simple, free tools to organize and secure their personal data, and companies get pre-approved audiences and only pay for conversions

premises.text: Intelligence portal and bank partnership connect data earnings into retirement/401k contributions
premises.evidence_span: We're working with a tier one bank to connect this directly into 401k contributions

value.text: Users take back control of their data and share in the monetization of it
value.evidence_span: Take back control of your data, and take back the billions that big data is earning on you

secondary_value.text: Ethically sourced, user-controlled data for businesses
secondary_value.evidence_span: This is ethically sourced data that's controlled by the user

causal_links.evidence_span: Data control should be a fundamental human right
